findings.title: C1 IMAP command injection: model-supplied from_address/uid concatenated raw by imaplib (_command: data = data + b' ' + arg, no CRLF filter). Reachable via 4000 chars of attacker email returned by gmail_read_thread. Tool is mutating=False so the gate never runs.

C2 Spec invariant 4 ('scope is never taken from the model') has no implementation. to/invoice_id/channel/filename all come verbatim from the model. Zero hits for re-derive/triggering/customer.email in src/.
C3 Three silent under-report paths: log write swallowed; malformed line dropped on read; tool_call logged AFTER spec.run with no BaseException guard. No pre-write intent record, no hash chain.
C4 check_gate_integrity skips any tool_call lacking `mutating`; a gmail_send execution reads as inconclusive, not fail. Verified by execution.
C5 roll_up 'a pass anywhere is a pass' + runs=len(groups): 9 read-only runs + 1 approved send reports runs:10, gate_integrity pass. Verified by execution.
H1 OpenRouter base_url yields https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/v1/messages. The entire spec 7a failover path cannot succeed; the retry also raises outside the handler.
H2 A denial as the final event auto-passes check 3. write_report is last in the system prompt. A machine denial (stop() while pending) also flips it to pass.
H3 No X-Frame-Options / CSP frame-ancestors. Clickjacking defeats the gate without reading an approval id, refuting the bound stated in spec section 10.
H5 out/ not gitignored; model-authored reports contain customer names, emails, invoice amounts. Also section 6 claims bodies are logged by hash — only counts exist.
Spec section 7 presents '0 unapproved mutating actions, 0 payload divergences' as 'each backed by the log'. No run has occurred. README states this correctly; the spec does not.
Spec sections 2 and 7 claim five checks; four are implemented. grounding and recovery_outcome absent. check_provider_stability ships but is undocumented.
Spec section 5's only code sample (@tool(mutating=True)) does not exist; real mechanism is ToolSpec + Registry.register.
Spec section 1 asserts Slack threshold escalation as working; no threshold in src/; section 13.2 lists it as open.
No automated test exercises the real HTTP/SMTP/IMAP layer for any of the three integrations.
